SELECT board_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO board ( seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{id}, #{title}, #{text}, #{color}, #{body_shape}, #{image_uuid}, #{image_original}, #{image_url}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, read_count AS readCount FROM board ORDER BY seq DESC

SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, read_count AS readCount FROM board WHERE seq = #{seq}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE board SET dislike_count = dislike_count - 1 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND dislike_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, read_count AS readCount FROM ( SELECT seq, id, title, text, color, body_shape, image_uuid, image_original, image_url, created_at, like_count, dislike_count, read_count FROM board ORDER BY like_count DESC, created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
